description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that adds rare Thinking Zombies with smarter AI, better awareness, stealth, self-preservation, equipment use, and limited control over normal zombies.

mods.name: The Thinking Dead
mods.description: Adds rare zombies that retained part of their human intelligence and physical coordination.

releases.notes:
First public pre-release of The Thinking Dead.

### Features

- Rare naturally spawning Thinking Zombies
- Slightly improved health, speed, damage and knockback resistance
- Natural weapons and armor
- Intelligent weapon and armor scavenging
- Daylight survival behavior
- Natural-spawning toggle
- Commands for status and summoning
- Vanilla model and resource-pack compatibility

### Known issues

- Thinking Zombies may pause briefly before entering shade or water.
- If no reachable shelter or water exists, sunlight-search behavior may stop prematurely.
- Multiplayer has not been tested.
